title: Injectivity of the prescribed scalar-extension twist map on the complete standard chart
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sfb-proj-scalar-extension-twist-chart-basic, for every positive-degree homogeneous f, the prescribed twist map on the complete standard open D₊(ψ(f)) is injective.

proof.text: Use the normalized surjective presentation c:S⊗H→Γ(V,r*twist 𝒜 j), and the injective normalized algebraic map L:S⊗H→B_(ψf).

At a prime x of V, compare the two localization compositions out of A_f by the universal property of localization. Naturality of η, its hypothesis hη, and the pure-tensor presentation formula show that ev_x(L(w)) equals the value of η(c(w)) for pure tensors; tensor induction gives the equality for every w. If η(c(w))=η(c(w′)), homogeneous-prime localization detection gives L(w)=L(w′), injectivity gives w=w′, and hence c(w)=c(w′). Surjectivity of c finishes.
